description: This file defines a set of invoke tasks for running tests, cleaning up test artifacts, and managing test coverage in a Python project. It includes task definitions for 'all', 'clean', 'unit', 'pytest', 'behave', and 'coverage', as well as utility functions for argument parsing and grouping. It also configures a namespace with these tasks and some default settings.

methods.name: test_all
methods.description: Runs all tests, including pytest and behave, based on provided arguments.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Cleans up temporary test artifacts such as directories and files.

methods.name: pytest
methods.description: Executes pytest with specified arguments and options.

methods.name: behave
methods.description: Runs behave tests with optional formatting and options.

methods.name: coverage
methods.description: Runs test coverage analysis with pytest and behave, and generates reports.

methods.name: select_prefix_for
methods.description: Selects the prefix from args that matches one of the given prefixes.

methods.name: select_by_prefix
methods.description: Filters arguments based on prefixes, asserting they are not options.

methods.name: grouped_by_prefix
methods.description: Groups arguments by directory scope for multiple test runs.
